lines.zh: 风一吹，我就飘着往前挪。
lines.en: One gust and I drift forward.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，走路只是假装。
lines.en: I have no weight; walking is just pretending.

lines.zh: 泡泡糖的味道一路跟着我。
lines.en: The smell of bubblegum trails behind me.

lines.zh: 糖果地面太黏，我踩着糖屑走。
lines.en: The candy ground is sticky; I walk on crumbs.

lines.zh: 我飘过半空，脚几乎没碰到糖。
lines.en: I float across the air, my feet barely touching sugar.

lines.zh: 别看我飘得慢，我上来得很快。
lines.en: Do not mistake my drift; I rise fast.

lines.zh: 一阵风把我推歪了三步。
lines.en: A breeze pushes me three steps off course.

lines.zh: 我像一颗被吹走的糖纸。
lines.en: I am like a candy wrapper caught in wind.

lines.zh: 脚下的糖屑在碎，我不管。
lines.en: Sugar crumbs crack underfoot; I do not care.

lines.zh: 我朝甜味更浓的地方飘。
lines.en: I drift toward wherever the sweetness is thicker.

lines.zh: 飘着飘着，我就到半空了。
lines.en: One long drift and I am halfway up.

lines.zh: 走路这事，对我太费力。
lines.en: Walking is far too much effort for me.

lines.zh: 我停在空中，像忘了往下掉。
lines.en: I hang in the air, as if forgetting to fall.

lines.zh: 脑袋里空空的，风穿过去。
lines.en: My head is hollow; the wind blows straight through.

lines.zh: 泡泡糖的气味是我唯一的东西。
lines.en: That bubblegum smell is the only thing I own.

lines.zh: 我在想事情，可没有地方存。
lines.en: I am thinking something, but I have nowhere to keep it.

lines.zh: 糖做的云飘过来，我让开。
lines.en: A sugar cloud drifts by, and I move aside.

lines.zh: 这么轻，连影子都不肯跟我。
lines.en: So light that even my shadow refuses to follow.

lines.zh: 我在数天上的糖霜，数到二。
lines.en: I count sugar frost in the sky and reach two.

lines.zh: 有风的时候，我就唱歌。
lines.en: When the wind rises, I sing.

lines.zh: 我的两只眼睛看着不同方向。
lines.en: My two eyes are looking in different directions.

lines.zh: 别摇我，我会飘走。
lines.en: Do not shake me; I will drift away.

lines.zh: 有时候我会忘记自己在哪。
lines.en: Sometimes I forget where I am.

lines.zh: 甜的空气吸多了也会腻。
lines.en: Too much sweet air makes even me tired of it.

lines.zh: 我在等一颗糖从天上掉下来。
lines.en: I wait for a candy to fall out of the sky.

lines.zh: 我这一颗心，跳得很轻。
lines.en: This one heart of mine beats very lightly.

lines.zh: 我飘在糖云边上，慢慢转。
lines.en: I drift by the sugar cloud, turning slowly

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就换个方向。
lines.en: One gust of wind, and I face another way

lines.zh: 你比糖块大得多，也重得多。
lines.en: You are much bigger than candy, and much heavier.

lines.zh: 你身上没有泡泡糖的味道。
lines.en: You do not smell of bubblegum at all.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，头本来就歪。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you; it was already tilted.

lines.zh: 活人，会走路，会抬头。
lines.en: A living thing that walks and looks up.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在跟着我转吗？
lines.en: Are your eyes following me around?

lines.zh: 我盯你很久了，其实才三秒。
lines.en: I have stared a long time, which is three seconds.

lines.zh: 糖果维度很少有客人来。
lines.en: We rarely get visitors in the candy dimension.

lines.zh: 你抬头的样子，像在找糖。
lines.en: You look up like someone hunting for sweets.

lines.zh: 我脑袋空，可我看得清你。
lines.en: My head is empty, but I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我会以为你消失了。
lines.en: Do not blink; I will think you vanished.

lines.zh: 你站着的影子压到我了。
lines.en: Your standing shadow is pressing on me.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像泥土，不像糖。
lines.en: You smell of dirt, not sugar.

lines.zh: 谁先眨眼，糖果就归谁。
lines.en: We stare at each other, who blinks first?

lines.zh: 你要不要也飘起来试试？
lines.en: Would you like to try floating too?

lines.zh: 你打中我了，我才一颗心。
lines.en: You hit me, and I have but one heart.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少了半条命。
lines.en: That took half of what little life I have.

lines.zh: 我飘不稳了，别再来一下。
lines.en: I cannot hold my height; please, no second hit.

lines.zh: 伤口在漏糖水，很黏。
lines.en: The wound leaks sugar water, and it is sticky.

lines.zh: 疼，但我的脑袋还是空的。
lines.en: It hurts, but my head is still empty.

lines.zh: 泡泡糖味混上了焦味。
lines.en: Bubblegum now mixed with something burnt.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛被你打歪了。
lines.en: You knocked one of my eyes crooked.

lines.zh: 轻的东西也怕摔。
lines.en: Even light things fear a fall.

lines.zh: 别追了，我快散架了。
lines.en: Stop chasing; I am nearly in pieces.

lines.zh: 我这具身体，撑不了几下。
lines.en: This body of mine will not last many blows.

lines.zh: 甜的？我本来就是甜的。
lines.en: Sweet? I am already made of sweet.

lines.zh: 你手里那块糖，我看看就好。
lines.en: That candy in your hand, I will just look.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是嘴馋。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I am simply craving.

lines.zh: 别晃那包糖，我头会晕。
lines.en: Do not wave that bag; it makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 糖果维度什么都甜，我照样想要。
lines.en: Everything here is sweet, and still I want more.

lines.zh: 你给的，我就敢吃吗？
lines.en: Would I dare eat anything you offer?

lines.zh: 闻着像薄荷，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: It smells of mint, which I do not much like.

lines.zh: 泡泡糖味的风，往你那边飘。
lines.en: Bubblegum-smelling wind drifts your way.

lines.zh: 糖纸归我，糖归你。
lines.en: I take the wrapper; you keep the candy.

lines.zh: 空脑壳也会馋，奇怪吧。
lines.en: Even a hollow head can crave; strange, yes?

lines.zh: 轻碰一下，我就转了三圈。
lines.en: One light bump and I spin three times.

lines.zh: 你撞飞我了，谢谢。
lines.en: You knocked me flying; thank you.

lines.zh: 我这身骨头是糖做的吗？
lines.en: Is this body of mine even made of bone?

lines.zh: 撞完我飘得更高了。
lines.en: After the bump I float even higher.

lines.zh: 别用肩膀顶我，我会散。
lines.en: Do not shoulder me; I will come apart.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你比较吃亏。
lines.en: We collided, and you got the worse end.

lines.zh: 我的重量还不到半块糖。
lines.en: I weigh less than half a candy.

lines.zh: 砰的一声，是我被弹开。
lines.en: That thud was me being bounced away.

lines.zh: 你挡路，我就从上面飘过。
lines.en: If you block the way, I float over you.

lines.zh: 撞歪了，我的头更歪了。
lines.en: That knock left my head even more crooked.

lines.zh: 我们两个加起来不到一颗心。
lines.en: The two of us together weigh less than one heart.

lines.zh: 成双的时候，风也变甜。
lines.en: In pairs, even the wind turns sweeter.

lines.zh: 我找不到伴，我太容易飘走。
lines.en: I cannot keep a mate; I drift off too easily.

lines.zh: 两颗空脑袋撞在一起，响。
lines.en: Two hollow heads knock together, and ring.

lines.zh: 我们并肩飘，谁也不碰谁。
lines.en: We float side by side and never touch.

lines.zh: 泡泡糖的味道混在一起了。
lines.en: Our bubblegum smells have blended into one.

lines.zh: 糖做的巢，风一吹就散。
lines.en: A nest of sugar scatters at the first wind.

lines.zh: 说好一起往上飘的。
lines.en: We agreed to float upward together.

lines.zh: 它有七只眼，我有两只。
lines.en: It has seven eyes; I have two.

lines.zh: 成对飞的时候，魔法弹更亮。
lines.en: Flying in pairs, our magic bolts shine brighter.

lines.zh: 我太轻，抓住的东西都飘走。
lines.en: I'm too light; whatever I grab drifts off.

lines.zh: 这么重的东西，我抱不动。
lines.en: Something this heavy is beyond my arms.

lines.zh: 糖纸我要，别的不要。
lines.en: I want the wrapper, nothing else.

lines.zh: 我用两只手指夹住它。
lines.en: I pinch it between two fingers.

lines.zh: 捡东西时我得先落地。
lines.en: To pick things up I must land first.

lines.zh: 风把它吹走了，算了。
lines.en: The wind took it away; never mind.

lines.zh: 我收集亮晶晶的小东西。
lines.en: I collect small shiny things.

lines.zh: 别给我太重的，我会沉下去。
lines.en: Do not give me anything heavy; I would sink.

lines.zh: 这枚糖球归我的口袋了。
lines.en: This candy ball goes into my pocket.

lines.zh: 捡完我就飘回天上。
lines.en: Once I have it, I float back up.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我的法术先亮。
lines.en: Something moves, and my spell lights first.

lines.zh: 你抬头了，正好。
lines.en: You looked up; perfect.

lines.zh: 我盯上高处，你恰好站着。
lines.en: I aimed for height, and you happen to stand there.

lines.zh: 魔法弹已经在我掌心转。
lines.en: The magic bolt is already turning in my palm.

lines.zh: 你离得太近，我就省事了。
lines.en: You are close enough, which saves me effort.

lines.zh: 我看不清你的脸，但我认得热气。
lines.en: I cannot see your face, but I know warmth.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，我不会追，只会打。
lines.en: Target locked; I will not chase, only shoot.

lines.zh: 上面看得清，你在下面。
lines.en: From up here the view is clear, and you are below.

lines.zh: 我的头空，瞄准却不空。
lines.en: My head is empty, but my aim is not.

lines.zh: 甜风把你吹到我射程里。
lines.en: The sweet wind blows you into my range.

lines.zh: 只有一颗心的东西，还想跑？
lines.en: A thing with but one heart, and you still run?

lines.zh: 我先开一枪，再看结果。
lines.en: I will fire once and then check the result.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶盘旋，慢慢来。
lines.en: I circle above your head, taking my time.

lines.zh: 你左右躲，我的弹也跟着转。
lines.en: You dodge left and right; my bolt turns with you.

lines.zh: 这一发要打你的影子。
lines.en: This shot is aimed at your shadow.

lines.zh: 别往上看，会晃眼。
lines.en: Do not look up; it will dazzle you.

lines.zh: 我的弹走直线，我走弧线。
lines.en: My bolt flies straight; I fly in an arc.

lines.zh: 你举盾也没用，我打的是空隙。
lines.en: A shield will not help; I aim for the gaps.

lines.zh: 十四点伤害，一次就够。
lines.en: Fourteen points of damage, one shot is enough.

lines.zh: 我在等风把我推得更近。
lines.en: I wait for the wind to push me closer.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your footsteps have gone uneven; I noticed.

lines.zh: 泡泡糖味会跟着弹一起过去。
lines.en: The bubblegum smell travels with the bolt.

lines.zh: 数到三我就放，一，二。
lines.en: I fire at three: one, two.

lines.zh: 你躲在树后，我从上面打。
lines.en: Hide behind the tree; I will shoot from above.

lines.zh: 弹在空中转弯，你不会相信。
lines.en: The bolt curves in midair; you will not believe it.

lines.zh: 我撞过来，这算近战吗？
lines.en: I bump into you; does that count as melee?

lines.zh: 我太轻，撞你也只有一点。
lines.en: I am so light that hitting you barely counts.

lines.zh: 别抓我，我的骨头是糖。
lines.en: Do not grab me; my bones are sugar.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，我的弹打不出去。
lines.en: This close, my bolt has nowhere to fly.

lines.zh: 我用额头撞你，它很硬。
lines.en: I headbutt you; my forehead is quite hard.

lines.zh: 一下就好，我没力气。
lines.en: One hit is all; I have no strength.

lines.zh: 你把我拍下来了，我才落地。
lines.en: You swatted me down; that is why I landed.

lines.zh: 近身我就吃亏，我知道。
lines.en: Up close I am at a disadvantage; I know.

lines.zh: 糖做的拳头，也会疼。
lines.en: A fist of sugar can still hurt.

lines.zh: 打完我就飘回去。
lines.en: Once this is done, I float back up.

lines.zh: 我从糖霜里冒出来，带着甜味。
lines.en: I rise out of the sugar frost, trailing sweetness.

lines.zh: 天上裂了一道缝，我掉了下来。
lines.en: A seam opened in the sky, and I fell through.

lines.zh: 糖果维度的风把我吹醒了。
lines.en: The candy dimension's wind blew me awake.

lines.zh: 我先有一口气，才有一具身体。
lines.en: First came a breath, then came this body.

lines.zh: 轻飘飘地，我就站在这里了。
lines.en: Weightless, I simply arrived here.

lines.zh: 泡泡糖的味道先到，我后到。
lines.en: The bubblegum smell arrived first; then I did.

lines.zh: 又是一颗空脑壳，又不请自来。
lines.en: Another hollow head, arriving uninvited again.

lines.zh: 我睁眼就看见糖做的天。
lines.en: I opened my eyes onto a sugar sky.

lines.zh: 这次我要活得久一点。
lines.en: This time I mean to last a little longer.

lines.zh: 我的两只眼睛还没对齐。
lines.en: My two eyes are still not aligned.

lines.zh: 从半空落地，脚都不疼。
lines.en: Landing from midair, my feet do not even ache.

lines.zh: 魔法弹在掌心自己亮了。
lines.en: The magic bolt lights itself in my palm.

lines.zh: 有人在这片糖地上放了我。
lines.en: Someone set me loose on this sugar ground.

lines.zh: 天气真甜，我先上去看看。
lines.en: The weather is sweet; I will go up and look.

lines.zh: 火烧起来，我像糖一样化。
lines.en: Fire catches, and I melt like candy.

lines.zh: 我从半空掉下来，摔得很轻。
lines.en: I drop from midair and land very lightly.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，可水让我变重。
lines.en: I do not breathe, but water makes me heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把我送出去好远。
lines.en: The blast sends me flying quite far.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，我几乎没动。
lines.en: The arrow passes through; I barely move.

lines.zh: 魔法碰魔法，我的弹灭了。
lines.en: Magic meets magic, and my bolt goes out.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我会发虚。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet I still grow faint.

lines.zh: 雷追着我，因为我飘得高。
lines.en: Lightning chases me because I float so high.

lines.zh: 底下什么也没有，我往下掉。
lines.en: There is nothing below, and I fall.
